author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: The Indian rupee has reached a six-month high against the US dollar amidst changing investment trends. Foreign investors returned to Indian equities, purchasing nearly $3 billion in recent days. This shift comes as global markets facing losses reconsider their heavy exposure to technology stocks linked to AI. Lower crude oil prices have also provided relief to the Indian economy amid geopolitical developments.
title: Indian rupee hits six-month high as foreign investors return to equities

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Pakistan's external borrowing is projected to reach $135.1 billion by 2025, with much of the debt owed to China. The country's external debt increased from $68.673 billion in 2015 to the current level, reflecting a significant upward trend. Public and publicly-guaranteed borrowing comprises the majority of this debt, totaling around $107.076 billion. Private borrowing is notably more expensive, contributing to rising debt-service payments across developing countries.
title: Pakistan's external debt nearly doubles to $135 bn in 10 years, China biggest lender

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy calls for a strategic shift in Ukraine's dealings with the United States, emphasizing the urgency of garnering bipartisan backing after the US midterm elections. He aims to reclaim essential military aid while stressing the immediate necessity for Patriot air defense missiles and the operational readiness of F-16 fighter jets as winter approaches.
title: Zelenskyy eyes bipartisan US backing amid Ukraine's Patriot shortage crisis

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: The Supreme Court has clarified that its March ruling will not impact completed appointments or promotions. Cases still pending will be examined individually by the courts based on merit and eligibility. The government expressed concerns that retrospective application could unsettle established positions and admissions. It sought two years to establish a uniform creamy layer mechanism across various sectors.
title: OBC creamy layer row: SC protects past jobs, promotions; leaves pending cases open

title: SC ends decades-old power tussle, Himachal to get 11,973 MU from Punjab, Haryana

title: Indian-American DOJ civil rights chief Dhillon resigns after GOP midterm rout

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Shubman Gill, captain of the Indian cricket team, emphasizes the importance of the ODI series against New Zealand, seeing it as a crucial preparation for the World Cup. He’s arrived early to adapt to the red ball for enhanced performance. India currently leads the series and is eager to clinch a win in Wellington, while New Zealand eyes a robust comeback.
title: ‘Conditions to be similar’: Gill on why NZ ODIs are crucial for 2027 WC plans

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
title: 'It was last to apply, meet security norms': Govt hits back on Starlink row

author: AADRITA HALDER
title: 'Will be dealt with iron hand': SC sends notice to Kerala Congress over CJI post

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: Aaryavir Sehwag and Lakshya Raichandani remained unbeaten as India chased down the target of 129 in just 19.1 overs, with 30.5 overs to spare. Sehwag scored 70 off 52 balls, hitting seven fours and four sixes, while Raichandani made 53 off 63 balls, including seven boundaries.
title: Sehwag's fifty, Ishan's three-for power India to 10-wicket win in Under-19 Asia Cup

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: The year 2026 is anticipated to be one of the warmest on record as global temperatures soar. Experts suggest that the prevailing El Niño will peak around this time, intensifying the risk of severe weather phenomena worldwide. The World Meteorological Organization warns of impending droughts and floods as a result, while projections hint that temperatures might rise even more in 2027, threatening existing climate balances.
title: 2026 set to be second-hottest year ever recorded; El Nino yet to peak

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: On November 6, WWE will unleash a thrilling episode of SmackDown, setting the stage for the Crown Jewel 2026 event. The highlight includes a fierce No-Holds Barred battle between CM Punk and Kevin Owens. Moreover, B-Fab and Michin will defend their Women's Tag Team Championship against the fierce duo of Fallon Henley and Lainey Reed.
title: WWE SmackDown November 6, 2026: Match card, segments and how to watch

author: YASHIKA BAJAJ
description: A bomb threat email was sent to the Bombay High Court, raising security concerns across Mumbai. Prominent locations mentioned include the Bombay Stock Exchange and Mahalaxmi Racecourse. The email also named Bollywood superstar Amitabh Bachchan's residence, Jalsa, as a potential target. Authorities are currently investigating the credibility of the threat and determining appropriate actions. Further details about this situation are expected shortly from official sources.
title: Bomb threat to Amitabh Bachchan's bungalow, Bombay HC, BSE on Dhanteras

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: China is significantly enhancing its helicopter capabilities, focusing on new attack and transport models. The People's Liberation Army's investments could shift military balance along the Himalayan frontier against India. India, in response, is strengthening its own helicopter fleet with various indigenous and foreign platforms. Both nations are prioritizing aerial mobility for effective operations in challenging mountainous terrain. The ongoing developments highlight the evolving military dynamics between India and China.
title: China's helicopter arsenal grows, is India ready for the Himalayan challenge?

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: A young engineering graduate from Kolkata is contemplating realistic salary expectations while starting his career. He seeks financial security without the pressure of affluent spending habits seen around him. Discussions on desired salaries and lifestyle choices have led to valuable insights from Reddit users. Varied perspectives highlight the importance of aligning income with personal financial goals. Ultimately, he aims to build a comfortable life without chasing high salaries unnecessarily.
title: Kolkata graduate, 22, questions salary race: 'How much money is enough?'

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Swati Jain crafted an innovative alternative to traditional firecrackers, using wooden ice cream sticks to celebrate Diwali. This eco-friendly solution not only involves her children in festive fun but also minimizes pollution. Debuting in Diwali 2025, the family combines these crackers with battery-operated diyas and organic colors for decoration, promoting a safer and sustainable environment.
title: Surat mother makes smoke-free Diwali crackers using 80 wooden sticks

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A British Airways captain was pulled halfway out of his cockpit after a window shattered at 24,000 feet in 1990. Two crew members held him while the co-pilot took control and made an emergency landing at Southampton.
title: Pilot sucked halfway out of plane at 17,300 feet survived as crew held his legs

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: The Delhi High Court ruled that the film Doosra violated Sourav Ganguly's personality rights, compelling producers to provide a bank guarantee. Despite this, the court allowed the film to continue its theatrical release, underscoring the importance of Ganguly's rights in the narrative. Producers are mandated to add disclaimers clarifying Ganguly's lack of consent for using his persona.
title: Delhi HC flags Doosra's violation of Ganguly's rights, orders Rs 2 crore guarantee

author: AASTHA JHA
description: Naresh Bhatt, an Indian-origin individual, stands accused of murdering his wife, Mamta Kafle. During the trial, he claimed to have discovered her lifeless body, asserting it was a case of suicide in July 2024. However, evidence, including surveillance footage and forensic analysis, contradicts his account, revealing blood linked to Kafle. Despite the grave allegations, Bhatt asserts his innocence and pleads not guilty.
title: 'She killed herself, I dumped body': Indian-origin man's on wife's murder trial in US

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Founded by Ashton Kutcher and Demi Moore, Thorn is dedicated to combating online sexual exploitation of children. Utilizing advanced technology, the organization helps pinpoint victims and provides essential support to law enforcement. In just six months, Thorn processed over 1 trillion files to identify harmful content. Through partnerships with various stakeholders, Thorn extends its mission globally, bolstering child protection efforts in multiple nations.
title: Ashton Kutcher's nonprofit flags 1.4m suspected child abuse files in six months

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Brian Devine, nicknamed "Clicky Ponting", has been banned from cricket for two years after a viral video showed him allegedly faking an edge by clicking his fingers. Saltburn CC’s second XI has also been relegated and handed a 60-point deduction. While several public figures criticised the incident, cricket commentators felt the backlash against the amateur cricketer was excessive.
title: 2-year ban for ‘Clicky Ponting’, England club relegated with 60-point deduction

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman held an internal Q&A after the US midterm results, where employees asked about data centres and public sentiment on AI. Altman acknowledged concerns over water use and said he understood why people may not want to live near data centres, The Wall Street Journal reported. The meeting came as OpenAI dropped NDAs with officials and pledged to pay full power costs at future sites.
title: What Sam Altman told OpenAI employees about data centres after US midterm results

title: Climate activists storm Microsoft data centre site in Amsterdam, several arrested

title: EC gives voters excluded from draft rolls in 7 states another chance to apply

author: AASTHA JHA
description: A fire erupted in three coaches of the Karmabhoomi Express in Patiala district, Punjab on Friday around 1pm. The sudden flames instilled fear in passengers as they spread quickly. Promptly, railway officials and emergency teams arrived to manage the situation, which was likely caused by a short circuit. Fortunately, all passengers were unharmed, and alternative transportation was arranged for their continued journey.
title: Watch: Karmabhoomi Express coaches gutted in Punjab; short-circuit suspected

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: Stock market today: BSE Sensex ended the session at 81,028.02, up 1,718 points or 2.17%. Nifty50 closed at 25,030.35, up 494 points or 2.01%. Global equities suffered a sharp sell-off amid fading enthusiasm for artificial intelligence (AI) stocks following US President Donald Trump’s defeat in the midterm elections.
title: Diwali fireworks continue as Sensex ends over 1,700 points; top reasons for rally

title: 'Long road ahead': Eisenkot beats Netanyahu 67-46 in backing but govt test looms

author: A SELVARAJ
description: Vivek, a driver, surrendered at Neelankarai police station for stabbing his wife Muthupriya to death during a quarrel. The incident occurred at their rented house in Palavakkam, resulting in Muthupriya suffering ten stab wounds. After the murder, he left their daughter with his brother in Mudichur. Family members revealed Vivek had a history of mental health issues and had received treatment recently.
title: 'Stabbed 10 times': Chennai man kills wife with kitchen knife, surrenders

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Australian cricketer Chris Lynn has been suspended for one month after testing positive for cocaine. His positive test occurred following the T20 Blast Finals Day on July 18, where he played for Northamptonshire. Lynn confirmed he used cocaine outside of competition and completed a substance abuse treatment program. His suspension was initially proposed for three months but reduced after treatment.
title: Ex-KKR cricketer tests positive for cocaine, serves suspension; here's what happened

author: TOI
description: Every long-haul flight with a toilet problem, is crying for a systemic fix. And it’s quite doable
title: TOI Edit: The loo crew

author: TNN
title: CERT-In seeks checks on access of AI agents

author: NITESH DUBEY
description: Saishiva Sankaran and Viswas Vijayaraj underline the challenges young Indian racers face in pursuing a career in motorsport, with limited testing, financial constraints and the demands of balancing education and racing. As they target Formula 1, both stress the need for greater support for Indian drivers to compete on the international stage. Their return to the Buddh International Circuit also brings back memories of India's previous F1 era.
title: 'The drivers are here': India's next generation of racers dream of an F1 breakthrough

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Dhanteras marks the beginning of the five-day Diwali celebration, filled with deeply rooted traditions and rituals. Families all over India engage in thorough home cleaning and acquire precious items such as gold and cooking utensils. Honoring Goddess Lakshmi and Lord Dhanvantari is pivotal, representing health and prosperity. Gratitude is expressed through shared messages and quotes among loved ones, symbolizing hope and the promise of fresh opportunities.
title: Happy Dhanteras 2026: Wishes, quotes and status for WhatsApp

title: Centre takes over 39.5 acres of land housing IAF’s sports complex at Race Course

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Canva has reported a layoff of 1,271 employees as it undergoes a restructuring process. Those leaving the company will get at least six months' salary and a year of healthcare coverage. To aid their transition, Canva will also provide a year of LinkedIn Premium access and specialized career support, as well as retain company MacBooks for these staff. This strategy reflects a humane approach to managing workforce reductions.
title: Canva lays off 1,271 staff, offers six months' pay, MacBooks and healthcare

author: OMJASVIN M D AND V AYYAPPAN
title: It's all about the Raman effect: From Transparent Chennai to City of Angels

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Devon Conway will miss the ODI series against India due to a concussion injury, making way for Nick Kelly to step in. Kelly is set to join the team in Wellington by Friday. In a positive update, Matt Henry has been declared free of concussion after a training incident. New Zealand faced defeat in the first ODI, despite a strong performance from Virat Kohli.
title: Big blow for NZ! Star batter ruled out of remainder of ODI series against India

author: PARTH SHASTRI
description: Seven Indian-American candidates achieved victories in the US midterm elections, marking a significant milestone for the community. Ami Bera won in California’s 6th Congressional District, securing his position as the longest-serving Congressman of Indian origin. Amish Shah became the first Indian origin person elected to Congress from Arizona’s 1st Congressional District, highlighting community advancement. Their campaigns focused on key issues like affordable healthcare and social security for constituents.
title: 2nd-gen Gujaratis script history in US midterms

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Recent surveys in the U.S. Virgin Islands have identified invasive species on several offshore cays. Black rats and green iguanas pose significant threats to local seabird populations, such as the red-billed tropicbird. Conservationists are now evaluating strategies to eradicate these non-native animals from the islands. Removal efforts could lead to improved nesting conditions for seabirds in the future. Successful initiatives may help restore these vital habitats for future generations.
title: Rats found on five of six islands in US seabird conservation survey

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In a heartfelt vlogging experience, a family of five showcases their life in a tiny Mumbai room, managing their daily activities on a modest budget of ₹6,000 monthly. The father elaborates on their clever sleeping arrangements to facilitate the children's education. This touching depiction of their living conditions has resonated with audiences online, igniting vital discussions about housing challenges faced in urban environments.
title: Mumbai man shares tiny Rs 6,000 room where he lives with wife, three kids

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Julia Child’s iconic home in Cambridge, Massachusetts, has found a new owner for $6.525 million. This historic residence, adored for its connection to Child's culinary shows, has seen extensive renovations. The original kitchen, however, remains untouched and is now a cherished exhibit at the Smithsonian Museum. To honor her legacy, a commemorative plaque is set to be installed at the site, ensuring that Child's influence on cooking continues.
title: Julia Child's former home sells for $6.525m; famous kitchen now in museum

title: Trai paves way for spectrum assignment to satcom companies

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In an Oregon land dispute, a property owner accused their neighbor of intentionally clearing land past established boundaries. A jury sided with the plaintiff, awarding them $810,000 in damages. The court upheld this decision, indicating that the defendants failed to provide valid evidence to counter their liability, while also noting that Bosma was aware of the boundary issues before the clearing took place.
title: Oregon landowner ordered to pay $810,000 after trees cut across property line

title: Oil price decline lifts mood, but volatility remains high
